Name: My Just Dance Opinions - A Custom Movie
Author: AranKatz179
Description:
Hello! This is my very first official stardew valley mod! [So please don't judge the quality of it, i just started doing this] So, Basically, I created my own Stardew valley custom movie! [Using the custom movies mod and its template] Its basically a short & sweet movie about me expressing my opinions about my favourite Just Dance Maps! [Currently It Only Goes From JD1-JD2015] And please accept my opinion, I may not like she-wolf like the rest of you. But at least i have my own opinion. Anyway, If y'all like this a lot, i might make a few updates, heck if this mod gets enough traction i might even make a part 2! [Detailing my favourites from JD16-JD20] SO Please Enjoy! -AranKatz

Required Mods :
- SMAPI (Obvious Reasons)
- Custom Movies
- PYTK
- Content Patcher
